options.content:
> ### ⚠ Scrape gap — no data source in the gardenio VM
> The **`gitlab_dark_*`** family (ahead / diverged / conflict / peelability / provenance SLOs) is emitted by a **monorepo-side exporter** and is **not federated** into `gardenio-vmsingle`. The Mirror-sync panel additionally needs **`kube_job_status_failed`** from **kube-state-metrics in the `gitlab-dark` namespace**, also absent here. Empty stats below are shown **neutral (no color) on purpose** — a green or red tile here would be a *fabricated* SLO verdict, not a real one. Ownership / federation decision is tracked in **ka-0000005317**.

panels.title: Dark-ahead distance — budget bound
panels.description: Commits refs/dark/integration is AHEAD of upstream/main. Unbounded growth = unpayable peel/rebase debt. Red once over the configured budget (gitlab_dark_ahead_budget_commits). NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is a monorepo-side exporter, not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — this reads empty here (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Diverged files
panels.description: Files differing between refs/dark/integration and upstream/main (the surface area a future peel/rebase must reconcile). NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — this reads empty here (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Conflict budget — parked/evicted topics
panels.description: Count of refs/dark/topic/* the rebase gardener could not cleanly replay onto fresh upstream (un-integrated conflict debt). Red over budget (gitlab_dark_conflict_budget). NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — this reads empty here (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Active drift SLO alerts
panels.description: Number of drift dimensions currently in a debounced alert state (ahead / conflict / peelability / provenance). 0 = all SLOs green — but empty ≠ 0: an absent exporter is NOT the same as zero alerts, so no 'or vector(0)' fallback is applied. NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — this reads empty here (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Dark-ahead distance vs budget (trend)
panels.description: Ahead-commit trend against the budget line. A rising trend approaching the budget is early warning that peel debt is outpacing peel throughput. NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — empty here (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Conflict topics vs budget (trend)
panels.description: Parked/evicted topic count vs the conflict budget. A sustained rise means upstream churn keeps breaking dark slices faster than they re-integrate. NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — empty here (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Peelability pass-rate — SLO floor
panels.description: Trailing-window pass-rate of peel-verify Gate 1 (does the requested slice build/test STANDALONE against real upstream main?). Below the SLO floor (gitlab_dark_peelability_slo) dark is drifting un-peelable. NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — this reads empty here, NOT a real SLO breach (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Provenance pass-rate — SLO floor
panels.description: Trailing-window pass-rate of peel-prov-verify (canonical Provenance-Hash three-way agreement). Below the SLO floor provenance is going stale / tamper-suspect. NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — this reads empty here, NOT a real SLO breach (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Peelability + provenance pass-rate vs SLO (trend)
panels.description: Pass-rate trend for both peel gates against their SLO floors. Sample counts (gitlab_dark_*_total) gate the alert: a thin window reads 1.0 and never fires a false breach. NOTE: gitlab_dark_* is not federated into gardenio-vmsingle — empty here (ka-0000005317).

defaults.noValue: requires gitlab_dark_* scrape — not federated into gardenio VM

panels.title: Mirror sync Job failures (BEHIND-lag / freshness health) — needs kube-state-metrics
panels.description: Failed gitlab-dark-mirror-sync / -freshness Jobs. The freshness monitor (mirror/freshness-check.sh) pages on stale heartbeat / auth / lfs / reject / consecutive-failure; this surfaces those as the BEHIND-lag complement to the AHEAD-distance panels above. (No textfile of its own — the heartbeat lives on the mirror PVC.) SCRAPE GAP: kube_job_status_failed comes from kube-state-metrics in the gitlab-dark namespace, which is NOT scraped into gardenio-vmsingle — this panel reads empty until that scrape is wired (ka-0000005317). An empty chart here means 'no data source', NOT 'zero Job failures'.

defaults.noValue: requires kube-state-metrics (gitlab-dark namespace) — not scraped into gardenio VM
